title: The release line names the served commit verified, and the failing case once one is broken
description: On a served static fixture app with a required case, the serving read the dashboard uses — master status's serving block over the API — reports the check the serve pass records for the exact commit it served, and the release line names the served commit and 'verified', then the failing case and its step once that case is broken. The command steps write the records the pass writes after running the fixture's required case, first passing, then broken.

steps.name: no leftover serve record, so the head reads as declaring nothing
with nothing declared the serving block names no check
the record the pass writes after the served fixture's required case passed
the serving block reports the verification for that exact commit
the release line names the served commit verified
the record the pass writes once that fixture case is broken
steps.run: printf '{"commit":"%s","url":"http://127.0.0.1:4399","failed":null,"reason":null,"pid":null,"check":{"verified":false,"case":"fixture-home","step":"step 2 expect text \\"the change\\"","reason":"expected status 200, got 404"},"at":"2026-01-01T00:00:01.000Z"}\n' 1234567890abcdef1234567890abcdef12345678 > .graphyard/served.json

steps.name: the serving block names the failing case and its step
the dashboard again, now serving the broken record
